items.exampleEn: This company makes products for babies.
items.exampleZh: 這家公司生產嬰兒用品。

items.exampleEn: I got a good deal on this TV.
items.exampleZh: 這台電視我買得很划算。

items.exampleEn: My uncle works in the tea trade.
The production of this car started in 2020.
items.exampleZh: 這款車在 2020 年開始生產。

items.exampleEn: Our budget for the trip is twenty thousand dollars.
items.exampleZh: 我們這趟旅行的預算是兩萬元。

items.exampleEn: I opened a bank account last week.
items.exampleZh: 我上週開了一個銀行帳戶。

items.exampleEn: The shop gives every customer a free bag.
items.exampleZh: 這家店送每位顧客一個免費的袋子。

items.sentenceEn: The customer wants to speak to the manager.

items.audioEn: Sorry, we can't buy that. It's not in our budget.
items.audioZh: 抱歉，我們不能買那個，超出我們的預算了。

items.sentenceEn: Their new product will be in the shops in May.
items.sentenceZh: 他們的新產品五月會上市。

items.sentenceEn: Can I put this money into my account?
items.sentenceZh: 我可以把這筆錢存進我的帳戶嗎？

items.stemEn: This year, the factory's ____ went up a lot.
items.stemZh: 今年這家工廠的產量增加了很多。

items.stemEn: Two for the price of one? That's a great ____!
items.stemZh: 買一送一？真是太划算了！

items.passageEn: Lisa has a small shop that sells soap and other beauty products. Her customers love them because they are made from natural things. Last year, she had a small budget, so production was slow. Then a big company offered her a deal: they wanted to sell her products in their stores. Now Lisa has three workers, and her shop is very busy.
items.passageZh: Lisa 開了一家小店，賣肥皂和其他美容產品。她的顧客很喜歡這些產品，因為都是用天然的東西做的。去年她的預算不多，所以生產得很慢。後來一家大公司跟她談了一筆交易：他們想在自己的店裡賣她的產品。現在 Lisa 有三名員工，店裡生意很忙。

questions.questionZh: 顧客為什麼喜歡 Lisa 的產品？
大公司給了 Lisa 什麼提議？
options: 出一大筆錢買下她的小店
在他們的店裡賣她的產品

items.promptZh: 台灣和日本之間的貿易很重要。
referenceEn: Trade between Taiwan and Japan is very important.
The trade between Taiwan and Japan is important.
rubricZh: 「⋯之間」可寫例如 between Taiwan and Japan

items.instructionZh: 用 customer 造一個句子，說說你當顧客的經驗，或某家店怎麼對待顧客。
referenceEn: I am a regular customer at this cafe.
This cafe always has a lot of customers.
rubricZh: customer 是可數名詞（例如 a customer、its customers）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 This cafe has）
